name: proto-lab-design-system
description: CapTech Proto-Lab design system: tokens, icons, and adoption tooling.

scripts.tokens:check: node scripts/build-icons.js --check && node packages/tokens/build.js --check && node packages/tokens/check.js
scripts.registry:build: npm run icons:build && npm run tokens:build && npm run registry:build -w @proto-lab/docs
scripts.check:scripts: node --check scripts/bootstrap.js && node --check scripts/export-icons.js && node --check scripts/e2e-registry.js && node --check scripts/build-icons.js && node --check scripts/sync-upstream.js && node --check scripts/sync-blocks.js && node --check scripts/sync-charts.js
scripts.upstream:sync: npm run registry:build && node scripts/sync-upstream.js && node scripts/sync-blocks.js && node scripts/sync-charts.js && npm run registry:build
